failed-rebind-retains-principal.reason: Frozen Go retains the previous authenticated principal after a failed Bind; subsequent Search leaks that principal's directory. Rust clears authentication before every Bind.
failed-rebind-retains-principal.mutant: oracle-mutants restores omitted unbind; scripts/test-authrt-ldap-mutants.py requires the recorded listener test to reject it

ldap-user-policy.reason: Frozen Go LDAP never performs EvaluatePostAuth after password proof. A user-scoped conditional-access block therefore does not restrict LDAP Bind. Rust applies the shared user policy after recording the verified credential result.
ldap-user-policy.mutant: oracle-mutants omits the post-auth pass; the recorded Bind test must reject the restored bypass

abandon-admission.reason: Frozen Go leaks a connection permit for each Abandon; sixteen unauthenticated packets permanently stop further operations on that connection. Rust releases the no-op permit.
abandon-admission.mutant: oracle-mutants restores permit.forget; secure socket replay must reject the restored stall

interleaved-valid-failed-binds.reason: Concurrent Bind futures in the previous Rust port allowed a delayed successful Bind to overwrite a later failed Bind. Rust now serializes Binds with all operations on that connection and clears the principal before admission, including a Busy response.
interleaved-valid-failed-binds.review: owner-approved security fix 2026-11-05; review fix requested 2026-11-06
interleaved-valid-failed-binds.mutant: oracle-mutants restores concurrent dispatch; scripts/test-authrt-ldap-mutants.py requires the TLS socket test to reject it
